description: This is a test suite file for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor module, containing multiple unit tests for markdown preprocessing functionalities such as image extraction, metadata stripping, and content cleaning.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test functions for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extraction of embedded data URL images from markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests handling of remote markdown images and their conversion into text.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Tests fallback to default text when images lack labels.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Tests processing of unicode characters preceding images.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Validates removal of inbound untrusted context blocks.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Tests removal of a single conversation info JSON block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Ensures all known inbound metadata sentinel labels are stripped.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Checks that json fences not associated with metadata are preserved.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Validates removal of envelope headers and message ID hints.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Ensures trailing untrusted context suffixes are removed.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Tests preservation of untrusted context when it contains user content.
